recommendation: Keep this audit commit on the combined branch and complete HL7/kindling#173. Consider manual core source cleanup only as a separate editor/work-group decision if the tooling fix cannot land before a publication deadline.
issue_request: FHIR-33170 is Applied/Persuasive with Modification and asks that if any element inside a BackboneElement is _summary, all ancestor BackboneElements are also _summary; the approved resolution says tooling should propagate those flags automatically and error when a summary BackboneElement has no summary children.
initial_application: Commit 2c7d674ebe5bfdd04b2239cbb6d5990931b20aad manually added isSummary=true to Provenance.agent, Provenance.entity, AuditEvent.agent, AuditEvent.source, and AuditEvent.entity. That corrected the seed's named Provenance/AuditEvent examples but did not implement the approved tooling behavior.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes classified the decision as FHIR-Tooling-Core. Later Zulip discussion and Jira FHIR-34180 show the problem persisted outside Security resources, including CareTeam.participant and Goal.target. The core repo consumes org.hl7.fhir:kindling from an external dependency, and HL7/kindling#173 is open/reopened with the FHIR-33170 resolution text.
reconciliation: No core source files were changed. A manual sweep of current StructureDefinitions would only paper over examples and would not implement automatic propagation or validation. The durable reconciliation is an external-repo audit that points the remaining work to Kindling.

related_jiras.note: Waiting for Input Patient Care issue listing CareTeam.participant and Goal.target; it explicitly waits for the FHIR-33170 tooling fix and was not decided in this default run.
